caption: The drawing depicts a square, off-white or light beige cloth featuring a central, eight-pointed star composed of small, diamond-shaped pieces. The star is made up of a repeating pattern of alternating red, green, and brown hues, with the innermost section being predominantly brown, followed by green, and then alternating bands of red and green as the star expands outward. The star's points extend almost to the edges of the cloth. Crisscrossing lines and subtle shading indicate folds and creases in the fabric, giving a sense of texture and depth. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the star being the dominant geometric element and the only object on the plain background.
title: Hand Made Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
